sources.title: Coast and beach landscape in U.S.jpg
sources.author: IIP Photo Archive
sources.description: Coast and beach landscape in U.S.
sources.anchors: Large rounded rocks fill the lower/right foreground; calm blue sea opens to the left; a green cliff slopes from upper right to center; distant dark mountains on the left; long blue-gray clouds. Preserve the diagonal shoreline and every major rock silhouette; no boats, people, gulls or new buildings.

sources.title: The reflection of a snowy mountain village (Unsplash).jpg
sources.author: Sveinn Birkir Björnsson sveinnbirkir
sources.anchors: A snowy mountain slope rises to upper right and occupies most of the upper image; a thin row of colorful waterfront houses and a small church across the lower-middle; pale green large house just right of center, dark red house left; still water below mirrors the village and mountain. Preserve building spacing and reflections; no stage frame.

sources.title: Desert Dunes (Unsplash).jpg
sources.author: Joe Mania joemania
sources.anchors: Wide 16:9 desert landscape. Intersecting sweeping dune ridges in the lower two thirds, central peak slightly left of center, darkest foreground dune rising on the right; distant hazy mountain ridge across upper strip and pale warm sky. Keep all ridge positions and the sparse small shrub lower left. No sun disk, camels or people.

sources.title: Ominous mist (Unsplash).jpg
sources.author: Dustin Scarpitti dusty_blanco
sources.anchors: Gray-green water in lower half, low drifting natural mist in middle, row of pointed conifers peeking through mist including a bare tree left of center; steep dark forested rock face fills upper half with a little snow at upper right. Preserve the existing mist extent and tree positions; no boats, buildings, calligraphy or extra peaks.

sources.title: Alpine meadows and mountains 01.jpg
sources.author: Thisik
sources.description: Mountains, meadows and cottages near Garmisch-Paterkirchen town (Alps, Bayern, Germany)
sources.anchors: Wide 4:3 landscape. Pale blue open sky in upper half; rugged distant mountain range with warm-lit tips; dark forest belt and a row of scattered wooden barns across middle, large barn right of center; lush green meadow below; one very small white dog just right of center in the grass. Preserve the tiny dog at its original size and location, all barns, mountain skyline and open sky. Translate grassy texture into fine directional stitches, never add decorative flowers.

sources.title: Casselman River Bridge, 2014-03-18, 02.jpg
sources.author: Cbaile19
sources.description: Old stone-arch National Pike bridge over the Casselman River at Grantsville, Maryland
sources.anchors: One historic single-arch stone bridge spans left to right across middle-lower area, the single arch is slightly right of center. White snow foreground with tracks; dense bare trees at right and evergreens far left; small picnic furniture right of bridge. Preserve exactly one arch, bridge masonry geometry, tree placement and snow; no invented water or people.

sources.title: Autumn River (128869533).jpeg
sources.author: Imagii
sources.anchors: Wide landscape: a winding shallow stream runs from upper center to lower right/center foreground; dark mossy boulders, rusty fallen leaves blanket both banks; thick tree trunk right of center and bare woodland beyond. Preserve the stream route, boulder positions, trunk structure and cool shaded lighting. No window, sunbeams or houses.

sources.title: Burano Island, Venice, Italy (Unsplash).jpg
sources.author: Pietro De Grandi peter_mc_greats
sources.anchors: Weathered blue house occupies left three quarters; dark wooden doorway below center-left with small canopy and house number 792 above, two tall shuttered lower windows flanking it, cropped upper windows; narrow stone-paved street and pastel buildings recede at right; diagonal shadows on wall and pavement. Preserve all openings, existing house number 792, cropped framing, street perspective and blue identity. No added text; existing tiny number remains part of architecture. Render as handmade unglazed colored clay relief with restrained depth, not toy proportions.

sources.title: Winding road (Unsplash).jpg
sources.author: Ján Jakub Naništa janjakubnanista
sources.anchors: Pale blue sky occupies upper two thirds, a small visible moon high slightly left of center; very flat green fields and fences at low horizon; narrow asphalt S-curve starts bottom center-left and winds toward horizon left of center; slim water ditch to right of road. Preserve huge sky, small moon, exact S-curve and fence positions. Subtle analog film color/texture only, keep photographic realism, no invented sunset sun or objects.

sources.title: Cape Reinga Lighthouse. NZ (20193721576).jpg
sources.author: Bernard Spragg. NZ from Christchurch, New Zealand
sources.description:
Cape Reinga lighthouse
The Cape Reinga lighthouse is one of the most important landmarks of Te Paki, and stands on the edge of a steep rocky cape, lashed by the Tasman Sea (to the west) and Pacific Ocean.
Originally, Motuopao Island was chosen as the site best suited for the location of a lighthouse to protect ships passing through the dangerous, turbulent waters at the northern tip of New Zealand.
However, by the beginning of WWII, it was decided that the light was in the wrong location, so in 1941 the glasshouse and light mechanism on top of the lighthouse were removed and re-erected at the new lighthouse settlement at Te Rerenga Wairua. The remains of the original tower can still be seen on the northern end of the offshore island.
First used in May 1941, Te Rerenga Wairua was the last watched lighthouse to be built in New Zealand. Standing at an impressive 10m in height and 165m above sea level, it is one of New Zealand’s iconic landmarks.
The Cape Reinga light today is electric, with the last lighthouse keeper being withdrawn in 1987. It is now managed remotely by computer from Wellington.

The 1000-watt light bulb magnified by the lens system throws a signal of warning 49 km out to sea and is often the first light in New Zealand that sailors see.
sources.anchors: White lighthouse dominates center, black-gray glass lantern with geometric glazing at top, two stacked narrow windows, solar panels on upper left front, red plinth along base; green hillside behind right and blue clouded sky. Preserve taper, glass structure, panels, windows and cropped perspective, use fine ink lines and sparse washes. No invented sea or new lettering.

sources.title: Golden-terraced-fields-in-Mu-Cang-Chai.jpg
sources.author: Malock2589
sources.description: Over time, terraced fields in the Northwest were created by the skillful hands of ethnic minorities, becoming a symbol imbued with cultural and historical values. Among them, the scenic terraced fields of Mu Cang Chai have been ranked as a special national monument. Coming to Mu Cang Chai, visitors cannot miss the raspberry hill terraced fields in Han Pulse village, La Pan Tan commune. Raspberry hill has a unique feature, a surprising convergence point that creates a highlight for the terraced fields here.
sources.anchors: Wide 16:9 harvested yellow-green rice terraces. Five small workers spread across lower-middle field; huts and poles in middle terraces; red-roof house high left; wooded hills rise around distant center valley. Preserve exactly five visible workers in same positions/poses and small scale, winding terrace edges and buildings. Thin torn/cut paper collage with no printed words; do not invent facial details for tiny people.

sources.title: Northern lights over a lake (Unsplash).jpg
sources.author: I'm Priscilla artographybyp
sources.anchors: Starry dark navy sky fills upper half; faint low green aurora glow just above snowy jagged mountain range across lower middle; dark conifer silhouettes in front, still lake reflection at bottom. Preserve skyline, understated aurora, tree positions and actual night; no moon, brighter invented aurora ribbons, lights or buildings.
